cases.title: Golden identity vectors
cases.expected: SDK digest/key matches every valid vector; invalid input is rejected before I/O.

cases.title: Unicode and case boundaries
cases.expected: No implicit normalization, trimming or locale-dependent casing.

cases.title: Pairwise same-resource contention
cases.expected: A acquires; B try returns busy; B succeeds after acknowledged release.

cases.title: Different resources progress
cases.expected: Independent names can be held concurrently without global serialization.

cases.title: Same-process non-reentrancy
cases.expected: Two acquisitions of one name are independent, even through the same lock object.

cases.title: Finite wait timeout
cases.expected: Timeout is distinct from backend failure and uses one monotonic wait budget.

cases.title: Try acquisition is not an expired RPC
cases.expected: One bounded logical attempt, no contention waiting, network budget still exists.

cases.title: Unknown acquisition response
cases.expected: Dropped success reply never authorizes work or returns ordinary busy.

cases.title: Delayed command after cancellation
cases.expected: A late response cannot create a locally live stale lease; cleanup/expiry is tracked.

cases.title: Cancel before send
cases.expected: No acquisition is sent and native cancellation is observed.

cases.title: Cancel during wait
cases.expected: Cancellation proceeds while another command is blocked; no immortal waiter.

cases.title: Cancel after remote commit
cases.expected: Uncertainty remains visible; bounded owner-specific cleanup uses its own budget.

cases.title: Lease expiry permits successor
cases.expected: Without renewal, a new owner progresses after actual expiry under the profile.

cases.title: Automatic renewal
cases.expected: A healthy renewed acquisition stays contended through multiple original TTLs.

cases.title: Conservative deadline from send
cases.expected: Delayed acknowledgement does not add a fresh full TTL at response receipt.

cases.title: Terminal lease never resurrects
cases.expected: Late renewal/acquire replies cannot revive Lost/Released/ReleasedUnknown.

cases.title: Renewal scheduling bounded
cases.expected: Many leases do not create one thread per lease or untracked perpetual tasks.

cases.title: Old-owner release cannot delete successor
cases.expected: A expired; B acquired; A release leaves B intact.

cases.title: Old-owner renewal cannot extend successor
cases.expected: A renewal after B acquisition is rejected or reports loss without mutating B.

cases.title: Repeated release
cases.expected: Idempotent local cleanup and safe remote owner-specific behavior.

cases.title: Release acknowledgement lost
cases.expected: Unknown outcome remains observable; no unconditional delete retry.

cases.title: Renew/release race
cases.expected: Serialized lifecycle and safe handling of delayed/out-of-order responses.

cases.title: User exception survives cleanup failure
cases.expected: Scope cleanup does not mask the primary user exception.

cases.title: Provider shutdown races
cases.expected: New attempts rejected, waiters cancelled, leases invalidated, bounded cleanup.

cases.title: Borrowed client ownership
cases.expected: Provider shutdown does not dispose a borrowed backend connection.

cases.title: Unavailable vs busy
cases.expected: Network/auth/backend failures are not ordinary contention.

cases.title: Capability requirement rejected
cases.expected: Redis rejects strong fencing; unknown profile does not silently downgrade.

cases.title: Protocol metadata mismatch
cases.expected: Conflicting namespace/profile/version is refused without alternate keyspace.

cases.title: Kill holder
cases.expected: After crash and profile expiry, a successor eventually progresses; no finally dependence.

cases.title: Pause beyond TTL and resume
cases.expected: Resumed stale process is not claimed to have been forcibly stopped.

cases.title: Partition beyond TTL
cases.expected: No live lease from unknown renewal; successor behavior matches the profile.

cases.title: Wrong Redis key type
cases.expected: Protocol/config error is reported; unexpected key is not deleted.

cases.title: Script cache loss
cases.expected: After SCRIPT FLUSH, renewal, release and stale-owner release preserve owner/deadline semantics; cached clients reload on NOSCRIPT while inline-EVAL clients are unaffected.

cases.title: Redis failover limitation
cases.expected: Reproduce/document the unsupported profile counterexample; do not claim prevention.

cases.title: Client offline queues and retries
cases.expected: No hidden reacquisition or ownership resurrection through delayed client queues.

cases.title: Distinct lease per attempt
cases.expected: Native same-lease no-op behavior cannot make independent attempts both own.

cases.title: Wait longer than grant TTL
cases.expected: Managed keepalive preserves a legitimate waiter, bounded by its wait deadline.

cases.title: Native key and create revision
cases.expected: Returned key is verified against expected lease; fence uses create_revision.

cases.title: Leader change in three-node cluster
cases.expected: Behavior matches documented native lock/quorum assumptions with trace evidence.

cases.title: Quorum loss
cases.expected: No successful acquisition without required authoritative evidence.

cases.title: Protected resource rejects old fence
cases.expected: After B registers its new fence, delayed A write is rejected atomically.

cases.title: Epoch change requires approval
cases.expected: Unknown/reset epoch never auto-resets protected-resource high-watermark.

cases.title: Clean installed-package consumer
cases.expected: Each claimed package builds/installs and runs sample outside the source tree.

cases.title: Mixed supported SDK versions
cases.expected: Current and supported prior SDK versions share identity/lifecycle semantics.

cases.title: Fixed bucket TTL refresh
cases.expected: Conditional update preserves ownership and validated expiry without delete-create.

cases.title: Conditional release and stale reads
cases.expected: Stale revision cannot mutate/delete successor; observations never authorize unconditional writes.

cases.title: Lost publish ack and deduplication
cases.expected: Unknown/retried publish cannot fabricate a successful current renewal.

cases.title: Three-replica failover/limits
cases.expected: Test actual profile recovery and limits; no silent eviction-based release.

cases.title: PostgreSQL metadata and advisory-key identity
cases.expected: The operator-provisioned metadata row matches the PostgreSQL profile and every SDK derives the same signed int64 advisory key from the identity digest.

cases.title: Private session contention and handoff
cases.expected: One physical session acquires; another session observes contention; the successor acquires only after acknowledged unlock and close.

cases.title: PostgreSQL capability boundaries
cases.expected: Fencing and TTL-based auto-renew are rejected before backend I/O; liveness renewal does not extend a server lease.

cases.title: Session loss and unknown mutation acknowledgement
cases.expected: Connection loss or an unacknowledged advisory-lock mutation never becomes ordinary contention or successful protected work.

cases.title: Metadata immutability, non-reentrancy and old-session release
cases.expected: Provisioning never overwrites a namespace row; a same-process second acquisition is non-reentrant; an old session cannot unlock a successor's acquisition.

cases.title: Metadata rejection and authentication failure
cases.expected: Missing or incompatible metadata and invalid credentials fail closed before protected work begins.
